# Pins below match the `evasion` conda env that the benchmark was developed
# and smoke-tested against. Upper bounds are set to the next major (or next
# minor for 0.x packages) to avoid silent breakage on un-tested releases.

# Core model SDKs (loc/chat.py).
# openai 2.x is required: the embedded gpt-5.2 / reasoning calls in
# loc/chat.py and sabotage/model_config.py rely on the 2.x API surface.
# google-genai 1.x rewrote types.Content / types.HttpOptions used in chat.py;
# 0.x will not import-match. anthropic >=0.50 needed for thinking-budget arg.
openai>=2.0,<3
anthropic>=0.50,<1
google-genai>=1.0,<2

# Env loading (env/api_config.py auto-loads env/.env)
python-dotenv>=1.0

# Sabotage uses inspect_ai with docker sandbox.
# Pin to 0.3.x — pre-1.0, minor bumps may break the agent/tool API
# (react, AgentPrompt, bash_session) we call in loc/tasks/sabotage/.
inspect-ai>=0.3.179,<0.4

# Data / utils
numpy>=1.24,<3
pandas>=2.0,<3
pyyaml>=6.0
tqdm>=4.65
requests>=2.31
tiktoken>=0.5
colorama>=0.4.6
